content: in february 2022 a civil case was heard in the vilnius city district court regarding the division of matrimonial property between two parties referred to as lg and zp the court decided to dissolve the marriage and awarded lg a land plot with a mobile home and a hyundai car lg was also ordered to pay zp a monetary compensation for a greater share of the property the court addressed various articles related to matrimonial property in the civil code lg brought the legal action seeking the dissolution of the marriage and division of property while zp raised independent property claims and alternative claims for division the court determined that lg should be awarded the disputed plot of land and mobile home and zp is ordered to pay compensation to lg the court also addressed financial obligations and ordered zp to pay a certain amount as compensation the court dismissed the case dissolved the marriage and held zp solely liable for certain bank obligations lg is required to return zps personal belongings and both parties have been assigned costs to pay
